content:
sara: starting SummitCare POC perf run now. goal: validate mixed query pattern (search+summarize) at 900 qps sustained with 2x microbursts to 2.5k. posting live notes.
diego: thanks. what's the exact mix and model?
sara: 70% embeddings (seq=96), 30% generation (seq=256, gen<=120). infra pool: 3x H100-eq, model = family/summit-7b-quant, batching adaptive, max_batch_tokens=4096, batch_timeout_ms=12.
eng-li: loadgen started. first 5m: sustained 920 qps, embed p50=28ms, p95=130ms, p99=410ms. gen p95=360ms, p99=1.2s.
ops-bot: autoscaler: pool at 98% utilization at 2087654387; reserved capacity reached; burst not enabled for this test.
sales-jordan: SummitCare asked: can you guarantee p95 embed <120ms? They want a clause in contract. Also asked about encryption of embeddings and data retention.
qa-rita: quick answers: embeddings encrypted at rest via KMS; retention policy configurable; SOC2 evidence available on request (type II - in progress). I'll follow up with docs link.
diego: logs snippet: 
```
[2087654390] req=E-01 slot=gpu-1 qlen=8 batch_tks=3600 p95=128ms p99=420ms gpu=86% nvlink=72% cache=0.94
[2087654391] req=G-11 slot=gpu-2 qlen=3 batch_tks=480 p95=340ms p99=1180ms gpu=45% nvlink=20% cache=0.97
[2087654402] req=E-90 slot=gpu-3 qlen=14 batch_tks=5200 p95=210ms p99=890ms gpu=98% nvlink=88% cache=0.61
```
diego: notice lower cache hit before the larger p99s. could be KV churn or batch oversubscription.
eng-li: hypothesis: mixed long gens interleaved with embeds cause KV eviction and large memcpy when a long gen lands on a worker with small cached KV. NVLink spikes align with those times.
ops-bot: profiler: detected memcpy spike and NVLink saturation at 2087654402 window.
infra-sam: reserved pool prevents autoscaler from expanding. If customer needs burst, enable burst window or temporary dedicated bump. Also can pin long-gen to separate route.
sales-jordan: SummitCare already asked for burst pricing yesterday. Need a simple statement: will burst remove these p99 spikes or only reduce queueing?
eng-li: short: burst adds capacity and reduces queueing-related tails. It won't fully remove cold-cache stalls caused by context churn. Combined approach: burst + cache sizing + routing gives best result.
sara: running quick reproducer with prefix_cache toggled and smaller batch_timeout: 
```
./loadgen --target 900 --burst 2500 --mix "embed:0.7:seq=96, gen:0.3:seq=256" --duration 600 --tag summit-repro
POST /admin/cache/toggle {"prefix_cache_enabled": true}
POST /admin/batch/config {"batch_timeout_ms":8, "max_batch_tokens":8192}
```
eng-li: test1 (cache off, timeout 12): embed p95=152ms, p99=460ms. test2 (cache on, timeout 8, max_tokens=8192): embed p95=98ms, p99=240ms, gen p95=280ms, p99=860ms.
diego: that's promising. cache + lower timeout helped median and tail overall, but gen p99 still high for some long generations.
qa-rita: from compliance side, summarize for customer: "We encrypt data at rest and in transit, provide KMS-backed key management, and can deploy Private for customer-owned keys. SOC2 Type II evidence available mid-Q3."
sales-jordan: I'll draft a one-paragraph note to SummitCare: explain expected improvements with config changes and an optional burst window; include a ballpark burst cost.
ops-bot: cost_estimate: burst enablement for test window ~+$0.10/min for expected 30m/day -> approx $90/month. (estimate)
infra-sam: recommending concrete POC plan: 1) enable prefix cache with tuned size, 2) create pinned-route for long-gen to 1 GPU-equivalent warm pool, 3) enable burst autoscale for two 30m windows, 4) run 30-45m validation with customer's live traffic.
eng-li: also suggest adding per-route max_gen to avoid single-request 1-2s spikes (or stream large gens).
sara: scheduled next run with burst and pinned route at 2087654600. I'll post the 45m summary here after.
sales-jordan: for contract language, propose: "p95 embed latency <=120ms under committed capacity; with enabled burst autoscale and recommended routing configs, p95 expected <=120ms for typical traffic but occasional long-generation events may exceed tail thresholds."
diego: if infra wants deeper traces during next run, ping me and I'll add token-level timing and per-worker KV stats.
ops-bot: change_request: enable_burst_autoscale(summitcare-poc) submitted by sara at 2026-06-11T10:20:00Z  pending infra-sam approval.
infra-sam: approved. enabling burst now.
sara: thanks team. will post final metrics once 45m run completes. :white_check_mark:
